nba.ot_prob_ratings_margin.measurement_fix: Step 1: regulation-margin mean mu from nba.rating_blowout_minutes_curve (opponent-adjusted net ratings x expected possessions/100 + home advantage, as of tipoff, adjusted for confirmed inactives). Step 2: P(regulation tie) = logistic regression of the indicator "regulation margin = 0" on |mu| over the last 5 regular seasons (about 6,000 games; league base rate to be estimated), smoothed across 1-point |mu| bins. Step 3: per-team OT points = league points per team per OT period from play-by-play scaled by the team's opponent-adjusted pace and offensive rating relative to league; combined OT points = sum over both teams. Step 4: P(k-th OT | (k-1)-th OT) = pooled empirical tie rate of five-minute periods with prior weight 200 OT periods. Output P(OT), P(2+ OT), per-team and combined OT-points distributions. Only team ratings, pace and results enter.

nba.pace.measurement_fix: Team pace = possessions per 48 minutes from play-by-play restricted to competitive minutes (score margin under 15 or before the fourth quarter), opponent-adjusted by ridge regression of game pace on offence and defence pace effects over the last 25 games (half-life 12 games), shrunk to the league mean with prior weight 15 games. Expected game pace = league + (paceA - league) + (paceB - league), lineup-adjusted by adding the minutes-weighted on/off pace deltas of tonight's expected-active players (k=600 possessions). No market total is used anywhere; any total comparison is a separate benchmark, not part of this input.
